name: Viktor
source:
Even though he’s only 23 years old, Viktor has made it his responsibility to take care of his two “baby” brothers. He’s very nice and always has a warm smile on his face. Viktor can be sort of a jokester and a prankster at times. He can be pretty stern to his siblings, however.

(Taken from [url=https://ainoshiki.wordpress.com/games/once-upon-a-hallows-eve/]dev page[/url])
